# Test Coverage Checklist: Basic Arithmetic Calculator

**Purpose**: Validate that all test scenarios and acceptance criteria are clearly defined in the spec before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is an author self-check artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when you confirm the test requirement is clearly defined and ready for implementation.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the test requirement criterion is satisfied and testable. It does NOT mean implementation or test execution is complete.

---

## Arithmetic Operation Testing

- [ ] CHK001 Are test cases defined for addition with all input types (positive, negative, decimal)? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK002 Are test cases defined for subtraction including result-is-negative scenarios? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are test cases defined for multiplication with edge cases (zero, negative)? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are test cases defined for division with non-zero divisors? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is division-by-zero test case explicit with expected error behavior? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Are mathematical correctness criteria quantified (e.g., "equal to within floating-point tolerance")? [Clarity, Spec §Success Criteria 1]

## Floating-Point Precision Testing

- [ ] CHK007 Is the floating-point precision requirement testable (0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3 not 0.30000000000000004)? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 1, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Are test cases defined for operations that produce long decimal results (e.g., 1 ÷ 3)? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the precision cap/rounding requirement documented with specific decimal places? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Input Validation Testing

- [ ] CHK010 Are test cases defined for non-numeric input (letters, special characters)? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Functional Requirements §6]
- [ ] CHK011 Are test cases defined for empty input fields? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are test cases defined for whitespace handling (leading/trailing spaces)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are test cases defined for leading zeros (007 → 7)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the error message requirement for invalid input testable (specific message text or acceptance criteria)? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements §6]

## Clear/Reset Functionality Testing

- [ ] CHK015 Are test cases defined for clearing after a successful calculation? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK016 Are all expected side effects of clear documented (fields empty, operation reset, results cleared)? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the "ready for new calculation" state after clear measurable/testable? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 2]

## Error Handling Testing

- [ ] CHK018 Are error scenarios explicitly testable (missing operand, missing operation, division by zero)? [Coverage, Spec §Functional Requirements §6]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the expected behavior for each error type (message, state change) documented? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements §6]
- [ ] CHK020 Are edge case errors (large numbers, precision limits) covered in test requirements? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements Testing

- [ ] CHK021 Is the performance requirement testable ("results display instantly under 100ms")? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria 4]
- [ ] CHK022 Are responsive design requirements testable for mobile/tablet/desktop? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Is usability requirement testable ("complete calculation in under 5 seconds")? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria 2]

## Negative Number Testing

- [ ] CHK024 Are test cases explicitly defined for negative operands (−5 + −3 = −8)? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is negative result handling (−5 − 10 = −15) explicitly testable? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Test framework choice (Jest, vanilla JS, manual) deferred to implementation phase; these requirements focus on test scenarios and acceptance criteria clarity
- Constitution's Correctness principle requires all arithmetic operations be mathematically verified; test cases above support that
- Constitution's Testability principle requires calculation logic be independently testable; consider unit test separation from UI in test plan
- Performance and responsiveness tests may require tooling (e.g., browser profiler); acceptance criteria should specify measurement method
- Add comments or findings inline as you review each item
- Link to specific test case implementations once tests are written
